100% human oversight on access control decisions

Full audit trail, GDPR-compliant decision explanations

Risk assessment with mitigation per layer
Conformity assessment (Module H: full EU auditor review)

data_residency.principle: No cloud egress - all processing local or Anthropic-hosted API

data_subject_rights: Access (Article 15): JSON export of all decisions affecting subject
Erasure (Article 17): Anonymization of non-critical records after retention period
Portability (Article 20): Machine-readable format of all personal data

consent_management.hotel_credit: Explicit consent at booking (per financial services regulation)
consent_management.glass_safety: No personal data (only production lot numbers + defect metadata)

retention_periods.school_access: Until student leaves school + 1 year archive

data_minimization.glass_safety: Production timestamp, defect location, image hash (no raw images)
data_minimization.school_access: Student ID, enrollment status, attendance (no biometric templates)

critical.definition: System failure affecting 10+ decisions or compromising human oversight

high.definition: System anomaly affecting 1-9 decisions or degrading performance
examples: MCP server timeout on 1% of requests

medium.definition: System behavior deviation without immediate impact

incident_response_process.post_incident_review: Root cause analysis within 5 days; corrective action plan within 14 days

export_metadata.verification_instructions: 1. Extract QR code from PDF signature page. 2. Decode QR: document_id + timestamp + digest. 3. Retrieve public key from AP2 ledger. 4. Verify Ed25519 signature against JSON structure. 5. Confirm timestamp matches KARP submission date.
